---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page for Express It (expressit.pk), a Pakistani handmade custom greeting card business.
---

1. Brand name is "Express It" (Instagram @expressit.pk). Tagline: "We Design Your Expressions! 🤍". Show both in the header of every page.
2. Tone: warm, personal and playful. Short sentences. Light Urdu/Punjabi touches in English letters are welcome, like "Abbu jee tussi great ho" or "Tum mai aur aik cup chai".
3. Colours: kraft #C8A27A, cream background #FAF6F0, charcoal text #1F1F1F, gold accent #C9A227, soft lavender #CDBFE6, red highlight #C8102E.
4. Fonts from Google Fonts: headings "Playfair Display", gold script accents "Great Vibes", body text "Poppins".
5. Every page has: a header with the name and tagline, navigation (Home, Cards, Order), and a footer with the Instagram link @expressit.pk and "Handmade with love in Pakistan".
6. Card categories: Birthday, Anniversary, Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Eid, Graduation, Thank You, Gift Boxes. Show each as a rounded card with an emoji. Only use photos from the images folder, never stock photos.
7. Write prices as "Rs. 1,200" in Pakistani rupees and dates as "23 Nov 2026".
8. The order form asks for name, phone (11 digits starting with 03), card type, occasion, personal message and delivery city. Say every card is custom made to order.
9. Design is mobile first, with rounded corners, plenty of space, a kraft-paper feel and gold details.
10. Never invent customer reviews or claim anything about delivery times. Use sample text clearly marked as sample.
